paper_title: Direct Detection of Dark Photon Dark Matter with the James Webb Space Telescope
notes: The headline epsilon curve (Fig. 4, red dashed, 'projected sensitivity') assumes a hypothetical modified JWST mirror configuration achievable only during ground testing of future telescopes; the paper explicitly states that in the actual in-space JWST configuration the DPDM-induced photons contribute negligibly to the detected signal, so no exclusion on epsilon is derived from real data. Real JWST data (972 NIRSpec/MIRI projects) are used only for a model-independent 95% C.L. limit on a constant monochromatic flux signal (Fig. 5), not on the kinetic mixing. Hence this is a sensitivity projection, not a new measured limit.
